title: ChemInform Abstract: Exchange Interaction in Multinuclear Transition‐Metal Complexes. Part 14. Exchange Interactions in a Novel Copper(II) Linear‐Chain Compound with Ladderlike Structure: Cu2(1,4‐diazacycloheptane)2Cl4.
abstract: AbstractX‐Ray structure analysis of the dimeric title compound (III) (space group P21/c, Z=4) confirms that the dimer is connected with neighboring dimers by Cu‐Cl····H‐N‐Cu hydrogen bonding interactions into infinite ladderlike chains.
